title: Physical Education
description: ICSE Class IX Physical Education: the compulsory anatomy, physiology and games-and-sports material, plus rules, skills, terminology, governing bodies and tournaments for the six prescribed games — published as eleven chapters.

syllabusBaselines.source: CISCE ICSE Physical Education syllabus, ICSE Year 2027 and Examination Year 2028 documents as reproduced by Scribd, AglaSem, Oswal Publishers and Jagran Josh (the Class IX structure is the same in both; cisce.org PDFs were not retrievable).
syllabusBaselines.note: Section A is compulsory human anatomy, physiology and games-and-sports material; Section B requires any two of six prescribed games — Cricket, Football, Hockey, Basketball, Volleyball and Badminton — so all six are registered. The paper is two hours, 100 marks, with 100 marks internal assessment. All eleven registered listings are published with validated boardprep-schema chapter content.

sections.title: Section A: Body Systems, Benefits and Games
sections.description: Anatomy, physiology and the nature and benefits of games and sports.

chapters.title: The Skeletal System
chapters.blurb: The bones of the major regions, the functions of the skeleton, joint types and the joint movements used in physical activity.

chapters.title: The Muscular System
chapters.blurb: Voluntary, involuntary and cardiac muscle, the muscles to be identified, and what exercise does for them.

chapters.title: The Respiratory System
chapters.blurb: The pathway of air, the mechanics of breathing, oxygen debt, second wind, lung volumes and exercise benefits.

chapters.title: The Circulatory System
chapters.blurb: Heart structure, rate and output, blood and its groups, blood pressure, and what exercise does for the system.

chapters.title: Games and Sports
chapters.blurb: The meaning and difference of games and sports, and their psychological and social benefits.

sections.title: Section B: Prescribed Games (choose any two)
sections.paperLabel: ICSE Class IX · Choice of two games
sections.description: Knowledge, rules, skills, terminology, governing bodies and tournaments for each prescribed game.

chapters.title: Cricket
chapters.blurb: The field and equipment, players and officials, the laws that decide play, core skills and the terminology of the game.

chapters.title: Football
chapters.blurb: The pitch and ball, referees and durations, restarts and offside, the skills of the game and its terminology.

chapters.title: Hockey
chapters.blurb: The field and equipment specifications, restarts and penalties, the skills of passing and dribbling, and terminology.

chapters.title: Basketball
chapters.blurb: The court, timing and possession, fouls and contact principles, skills and offences, and the terminology of the game.

chapters.title: Volleyball
chapters.blurb: The court and net, scoring and rotation, faults at the net and on service, skills, and terminology.

chapters.title: Badminton
chapters.blurb: The court, shuttle and racket, scoring in singles and doubles, the strokes and serves, and terminology.
